questions.help: 10 Special vehicles  Also, the drivers of special vehicles or whilst engaged in special transport purposes, will have to use the illuminated light, both day and night, whenever they travel on public roads at a speed that does not exceed 40 Km/h. Should this light fail, then the dipped headlight will have to be used along with the hazard warning lights.(Página 59 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
En caso de avería de la luz rotativa amarillo auto que utilizan los vehículos especiales, ¿se debe utilizar algún alumbrado?
Should any other lights be used if the automatic rotating yellow light used by special vehicles stops working?
